name: AI.FRAME

makers.name: Shenzhen Matrix Dynamic Technology Development Co., Ltd.

summary: AI.FRAME is a miniature humanoid robotics platform for programmable movement and hands-on assembly. The developer exhibited its AIF-44-0 Apollo robot kit at Maker Faire Tokyo 2016, describing control and programming through mobile apps or Windows software. The primary image depicts that Apollo kit variant. Current availability has not been verified.
